caseNameFull: Mackay v. Nesbett, Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Alaska
judges: Douglas, File, Granted, Leave, Motion, Should, That

opinions.text:
396 U. S. 960. Motion to dispense with printing petition granted. Motion for leave to file petition for rehearing denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that the motion for leave to file petition for rehearing should be granted.
